row.evidence: GoodData Cloud's docs recommend automating user creation "either through the use of JIT user provisioning or by creating an automated pipeline using the API"; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Scored as GoodData Cloud (gooddata.ai). Two tiers, both sales-quoted: Professional (per-workspace pricing: platform fee + number of workspaces, unlimited users) and Enterprise (custom pricing). OIDC SSO with the customer's IdP is in Professional; SAML, multiple OIDC providers (Federated Identity Management) and the Audit Log are Enterprise only. No SCIM: users are created by OIDC/SAML JIT on login or through the REST entity and userManagement APIs (create, update, delete users and groups, assign permissions); JIT does not deprovision. Okta's OIN 'GoodData' app (last updated 2019) offers SAML and SWA only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds SAML, multiple OIDC providers and the Audit Log (delivered to the customer's S3 bucket).

scim.notes: GoodData Cloud documents only two automation paths, OIDC/SAML JIT and its REST API; no SCIM endpoint appears in the docs sitemap or API reference. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Bearer API token in the Authorization header; no other schemes supported.

capabilities.notes: Roles are expressed as permissions on the organization, workspaces and data sources, assigned to users or user groups.

endpoints.purpose: List users with groups and permissions
Add members to a user group
Remove members from a user group

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Log (Enterprise only) is delivered in batches to the customer's own AWS S3 bucket, not through a query API; it records USER_CREATE/USER_UPDATE and login events.

okta.notes: OIN app marks SAML and SWA (read from page markup), last updated Dec. 17 2019; no provisioning.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found; GoodData docs cover Entra ID as a custom OIDC provider.

fallbacks.notes: JIT works with OIDC on Professional and with SAML/multiple OIDC under Enterprise Federated Identity Management.
